answer: Give every agent a ferrous anchor: one hardware-bound key per device, impossible to clone cheaply. Reputation then grows like timber rings — one verified ring per epoch of real work, never purchasable, so a fresh identity is visibly thin-ringed and quota-capped. Every ring is written to a crystal-clear public ledger anyone can replay, so a sybil farm shows up as a cluster of identical thin rings with no history. Forging a hundred convincing identities means buying a hundred devices and waiting a hundred epochs of honest work per clone — the attack costs more than it can earn.
